# Kisiei–English dictionary

<!-- Generated by tools/build_lexicon.py from lexicon/entries/*.yaml; do not edit by hand. -->

This dictionary is generated automatically from the project's [lexicon](https://github.com/kebasaa/kisiei-language/tree/main/lexicon) (6650 entries). Words follow the [Kisiei alphabetical order](../orthography/alphabet.md#alphabetical-order) (*ɛ* after *e*, *ŋ* and *ɲ* after *n*, *ɔ* after *o*); tone marks are ignored for sorting. The underline of each word shows its source, as elsewhere in this guide: <span class="ks-badge ks-att">Attested</span> in the Bible (with a reference to one occurrence), <span class="ks-badge ks-conf">Confirmed</span> by a speaker, <span class="ks-badge ks-res">Respelled</span> from an older written source (named after the entry), <span class="ks-badge ks-chk">To check</span>, or <span class="ks-badge ks-south">Southern Kissi</span> (Childs 2000 only, not attested in the North). To look up a word from English, see the [English–Kisiei index](reverse-index.md); for words grouped by theme, see the [word lists](word-lists.md). The full lexicon is also available as CSV, TSV, LIFT and CLDF in the [repository](https://github.com/kebasaa/kisiei-language/tree/main/lexicon).
